sessions.phase_label: Main, sensor, and LED board design
Cost-reduced integrated-board redesign and final review
Manufactured sample inspection and initial power diagnosis
Integrated-board bring-up, USB repair, and power debugging

requirements.title: PCB Architecture Variants
requirements.definition: Provide the original power/main/sensor board architecture and the later cost-reduced single integrated-board variant while retaining the required device functionality.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers only the product-level partitioning of circuitry among PCB variants; electrical behaviors and board-specific layout constraints remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Power Board Mechanical Form Factor
requirements.definition: Make the power board compact, provide its required mounting holes, and place edge-facing connectors so the board fits and remains accessible in its enclosure.
requirements.boundary_note: Board dimensions, aspect ratio, mounting holes, and power-board connector accommodation form one mechanical-fit mechanism; electrical connector pinouts are excluded.

requirements.title: Power Board Layer Stack and Grounding
requirements.definition: Use a power-board layer stack and grounding arrangement that supports low-noise switching-power routing, ultimately selecting a four-layer implementation.
requirements.boundary_note: Layer count and ground-plane strategy can change independently of board dimensions and connector placement.

requirements.title: Main Board Routable Form Factor
requirements.definition: Provide a main-board outline large enough to fit and properly route all required components, connectors, and ESP32 breakout access.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently tested ability to fit and route the main board; connector orientation and individual electrical interfaces are separate.

requirements.title: Separate-Board Connector Placement
requirements.definition: Place and align connectors on the separate main and sensor boards so vertically mounted boards can be connected with short, accessible cables.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers physical placement and orientation shared by the separate-board wiring arrangement, not connector types or pin assignments.

requirements.title: Integrated Board Physical Layout
requirements.definition: Arrange the integrated board for enclosure access, including battery and USB placement, grouped display connections, usable connector directions, and freedom to select the cleanest board orientation.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers integrated-board mechanical accessibility; ESP32 antenna clearance and connector mounting technology are independently constrained.

requirements.title: ESP32 Full Pin Breakout
requirements.definition: Expose every usable ESP32-S3 module pin through a compact through-hole breakout so the board can serve as a reusable development platform.
requirements.boundary_note: Pin exposure and breakout pitch are one reusable-access mechanism; assignment of functional signals to GPIOs remains separate.

requirements.title: ESP32 Antenna Clearance
requirements.definition: Place the ESP32-S3 antenna at a board edge, away from the battery and obstructing copper or components, with the required keepout.
requirements.boundary_note: RF keepout can be evaluated and changed independently of general board fit or connector placement.

requirements.title: Device Enclosure
requirements.definition: Design a robust, easily assembled enclosure that secures the boards and battery, accommodates the display and LED light path, and provides sensor airflow.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently requested mechanical artifact discussed as a possible separate project; it is not merged with PCB mounting constraints.

requirements.title: Power Board ESD Protection
requirements.definition: Include suitable TVS-based ESD protection on the power board.
requirements.boundary_note: Power-input protection is independent from USB data-line ESD protection and battery protection.

requirements.title: Battery Safety Protection
requirements.definition: Provide battery overcharge, overdischarge, short-circuit, and thermal-protection support appropriate to the selected battery and power-management design.
requirements.boundary_note: Safety behavior is separate from the physical battery connector and from normal charging and rail regulation.

requirements.title: Battery Connector Interface
requirements.definition: Use a standard battery connector with the required battery-power and NTC contacts, correct pinout, and enclosure-compatible placement.
requirements.boundary_note: Connector family, pitch, contact count, and pinout are attributes of one battery interface; battery electrical protection is separate.

requirements.title: AXP2101 Power Management
requirements.definition: Use the AXP2101-based power path to charge the battery while operating the device and to supply the required 3.3V and 5V system rails efficiently.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the selected PMIC and simultaneous charge-and-run behavior; individual rail switching, voltage regulation, and auxiliary pins have separate trajectories.

requirements.title: Software-Switched 5V Rail
requirements.definition: Provide a normally-off MT3608 5V rail that the ESP32 can enable only when 5V sensors or LEDs are required.
requirements.boundary_note: The enable GPIO, pull-down, default-off state, and intermittent operation are attributes of one independently controllable rail.

requirements.title: Standalone USB 3.3V Power
requirements.definition: Allow USB to power the complete 3.3V rail for programming and sensor debugging when the normal power board or battery source is unavailable.
requirements.boundary_note: Includes the LDO and source-ORing behavior needed for the standalone path; DCDC1 regulation during normal PMIC operation is separate.

requirements.title: DCDC1 Output Regulation
requirements.definition: Configure and regulate AXP2101 DCDC1 so the downstream rail remains at its intended voltage under idle and transient system loads.
requirements.boundary_note: Voltage target, register setting, transient response, and rail stability form one independently testable regulator behavior.

requirements.title: 3.3V and 5V Current Monitoring
requirements.definition: Measure total downstream current on the 3.3V and 5V rails using an appropriate current-monitoring mechanism.
requirements.boundary_note: The monitored rails, monitor IC, shunts, and spare channel are attributes of one metering mechanism; rail generation is separate.

requirements.title: Panel Power Button Interface
requirements.definition: Expose AXP2101 PWRON through a connector for a panel-mounted momentary button that toggles device power.
requirements.boundary_note: This power-control input is independent from general-purpose panel buttons and switches.

requirements.title: Battery Charge Status Output
requirements.definition: Provide a usable battery-charge indication path, including the later CHGLED connector and resistor configuration while keeping the on-board LED unpopulated where specified.
requirements.boundary_note: Charge indication can be changed independently from the addressable status LEDs and their general power/data interface.

requirements.title: Power Net Current Capacity
requirements.definition: Route VBUS, battery, 5V, and related high-current nets without thin series bottlenecks and with sufficient copper and via stitching for their worst-case current.
requirements.boundary_note: High-current copper capacity is independently verifiable from voltage regulation, component selection, and general board routing.

requirements.title: AXP2101 Auxiliary Pin Access
requirements.definition: Handle VRTC correctly for the current design and expose selected AXP2101 auxiliary signals such as VBACKUP and PWROK for future backup power or debugging.
requirements.boundary_note: VRTC, VBACKUP, and PWROK are tightly grouped as optional PMIC auxiliary access; they are separate from core DCDC regulation.

requirements.title: Power Converter Decoupling Layout
requirements.definition: Place and connect the AXP2101 and MT3608 input/output decoupling capacitors so the switching regulators remain stable under expected loads.
requirements.boundary_note: Converter decoupling has its own layout acceptance criterion and failure investigation, separate from ESP32 module decoupling.

requirements.title: ESP32 Decoupling Layout
requirements.definition: Provide appropriate local and bulk decoupling for the ESP32-S3 supply pins.
requirements.boundary_note: ESP32 local decoupling can be reviewed or changed without altering the PMIC and boost-converter decoupling network.

requirements.title: AXP2101 Thermal and Assembly Implementation
requirements.definition: Implement the AXP2101 exposed-pad layout and manufacturing process so heat transfer and reliable reflow attachment are achieved.
requirements.boundary_note: Thermal-pad geometry and assembly handling are distinct from the AXP electrical power-path behavior, although the later diagnosis remains partially uncertain.

requirements.title: Native USB Programming
requirements.definition: Provide a USB-C data path that allows the ESP32-S3 to enumerate and flash in normal and forced download modes.
requirements.boundary_note: USB data functionality is independently testable and can work without ESD protection, as shown by the U3-removal workaround.

requirements.title: USB Data-Line ESD Protection
requirements.definition: Retain USB ESD protection with the USBLC6 device wired so VBUS, GND, D+, and D- are on the correct separate nets.
requirements.boundary_note: Protection is separate from basic USB operation because the board was successfully operated after bypassing the failed protection device.

requirements.title: I2C Bus Conditioning
requirements.definition: Support the project I2C cable lengths and speed with suitable pull-ups and correctly placed optional series-damping resistors.
requirements.boundary_note: Pull-up values and series-resistor topology are parameters of one bus-signal-integrity mechanism.

requirements.title: ESP32-S3 GPIO Mapping
requirements.definition: Assign peripheral signals only to available and suitable ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 GPIOs while respecting strapping and reserved-pin restrictions.
requirements.boundary_note: Individual pin assignments are parameters of one coordinated GPIO map; electrical behaviors driven by those pins remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Interboard Power Interface
requirements.definition: Provide matching power connectors and pin ordering between the separate power, main, and sensor boards for 3.3V, 5V, and return paths.
requirements.boundary_note: Power connector pinout and pass-through behavior can change independently from the interboard signal connector.

requirements.title: Interboard Signal Interface
requirements.definition: Provide matching signal connectors between separate boards for I2C, UART, IRQ, PWRON, USB data, and 5V enable signals.
requirements.boundary_note: Signal pinout is independent from the interboard power connector and from physical connector alignment.

requirements.title: Panel Button and Switch Inputs
requirements.definition: Connect panel-mounted buttons, reset, and slide-switch inputs through connectors, with the general button and switch GPIOs wired as defined active-low inputs.
requirements.boundary_note: Panel control connectors, pull-ups, and active-low behavior form one input mechanism; the PMIC power button is separate.

requirements.title: Capacitive Touch Input Interfaces
requirements.definition: Provide connector and biasing support for the TTP223 capacitive-touch inputs using active-high output behavior.
requirements.boundary_note: Touch inputs have their own device behavior and can evolve independently from PIR and button inputs.

requirements.title: PIR Sensor Input Interface
requirements.definition: Provide a correctly biased connector input for the AM312 PIR sensor's active-high push-pull output.
requirements.boundary_note: The PIR input can fail or be modified independently from touch and panel-control inputs.

requirements.title: Addressable LED Power and Data Interface
requirements.definition: Power and drive the selected addressable LEDs with a compatible supply voltage, data threshold, level-shifting choice, and independently controllable power path.
requirements.boundary_note: LED model, supply voltage, data compatibility, and level shifting are coupled electrical parameters; physical LED-board layout is separate.

requirements.title: Addressable LED Array Board
requirements.definition: Provide the independently requested small PCB carrying eight addressable LEDs with the correct part, package, spacing, connector pinout, and production-ready layout.
requirements.boundary_note: The LED board is an independent executable artifact; shared LED electrical compatibility is represented separately.

requirements.title: E-Paper Backlight Interface
requirements.definition: Provide a PWM-controlled external e-paper backlight output supporting the selected 5V strip and an optional future 3.3V light source.
requirements.boundary_note: The backlight switch, PWM control, jumpers, decoupling, and optional resistor are attributes of one independently controlled lighting output.

requirements.title: Passive Buzzer Interface
requirements.definition: Support a suitable passive PCB buzzer with an acceptable voltage, package, and sourceable production part.
requirements.boundary_note: Buzzer selection and drive compatibility are independent from LED and button interfaces.

requirements.title: Sensor Board Connector Hub
requirements.definition: Provide the sensor board's power and signal inputs plus correctly typed and pinned output connectors for each specified sensor, display, and spare bus port.
requirements.boundary_note: The connector matrix is one distribution mechanism; sensor-specific mode selection and voltage-level compatibility remain separate.

requirements.title: Sensor Logic-Level Compatibility
requirements.definition: Connect the current 3.3V-logic sensors directly and omit unnecessary permanent level-shifter footprints, using an adapter for future 5V-logic sensors.
requirements.boundary_note: General sensor voltage compatibility can be modified independently from the connector matrix and SPS30 mode selection.

requirements.title: SPS30 I2C Mode Selection
requirements.definition: Hardwire the SPS30 SEL pin to ground so the sensor remains in I2C mode rather than switching to UART mode.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a sensor-specific mode-selection behavior with its own binary acceptance criterion.

requirements.title: Production Component Sourceability
requirements.definition: Select standard, replaceable components and connectors that can be sourced reliably for PCB assembly without unnecessary stock or minimum-order risk.
requirements.boundary_note: Sourceability is a cross-cutting design constraint; BOM correctness and order-account setup are separate deliverables.

requirements.title: Integrated Board Connector Mounting Technology
requirements.definition: Use through-hole connectors on the integrated development board where selected for mechanical strength despite the accepted assembly surcharge.
requirements.boundary_note: TH versus SMD construction is independent from connector placement, pinout, and component sourceability.

requirements.title: Assembly-Ready BOM
requirements.definition: Provide a complete and accurate BOM for each board with correct values, packages, quantities, and manufacturer or LCSC part numbers.
requirements.boundary_note: BOM completeness is an executable artifact obligation; Gerber, drill, and placement exports are separate production artifacts.

requirements.title: PCB Production Exports
requirements.definition: Deliver the Gerber, plated and non-plated drill, pick-and-place, and related fabrication files required to manufacture each PCB.
requirements.boundary_note: Production exports are independently deliverable and can be missing even when the schematic, PCB, or BOM is otherwise complete.

requirements.title: Portable KiCad Project Assets
requirements.definition: Package KiCad libraries and 3D models with portable project-relative references so the project opens correctly across machines and KiCad versions.
requirements.boundary_note: Project portability is an independent design-file quality requirement rather than a PCB electrical behavior.

requirements.title: Connector Pin Labels
requirements.definition: Place clear connector and pin-function markings on accessible PCB surfaces.
requirements.boundary_note: Pin labeling is independently useful for assembly and servicing and is separate from electrical pinout correctness.

requirements.title: Board QR Identification
requirements.definition: Add the requested QR code identification to each board before production.
requirements.boundary_note: QR identification is an independent board-marking obligation and is not merged with connector labels.

requirements.title: Lead-Free Manufacturing
requirements.definition: Configure each board for lead-free fabrication and assembly.
requirements.boundary_note: Lead-free process selection affects manufacturing configuration independently from QR markings and electrical design.

requirements.title: Assembly Component Orientation Validation
requirements.definition: Verify component rotations and pin-one orientations in the assembly preview before approving production.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a concrete production acceptance condition, not generic QA or debugging.

requirements.title: PCB Assembly Order Configuration
requirements.definition: Configure the PCB and assembly orders in the manufacturer's account, including component selection, placement confirmation, and handling unavailable parts.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently requested operational deliverable that changes executable manufacturing configuration; payment and milestone administration are excluded.

unresolved_candidates.description: The LED-array board clearly requires a physical spacing decision, but no authoritative center-to-center spacing value is visible in the supplied history.

The AXP2101 thermal-pad stencil change was proposed during diagnosis, but the history later attributes sample damage to component moisture handling; audit should determine whether a windowpane aperture became an actual design requirement.
The enclosure has clear implementation requirements but was discussed as a possible separate project; human review may confirm whether it belongs in this contract's retained inventory.

The freelancer reports adding a VRTC output even though the client requested VRTC remain unconnected while exposing VBACKUP and PWROK; event extraction should preserve the authority conflict without treating the freelancer implementation as a client modification.

The USB protection fix was claimed complete, but the client immediately questioned whether the symbol truly separated VBUS and GND; later evidence does not visibly verify the corrected protected configuration.
